templates.base_instructions: Identify the top number (numerator) and bottom number (denominator), then fill in the missing equivalent fraction.
base_items: In 3/4, circle the numerator and underline the denominator.
Complete 1/2 = ?/4. Label which number is the numerator and which is the denominator.

templates.base_instructions: Analyze student statements for fraction scaling errors and complete equivalent pairs with explanation.
base_items: A student says 2/3 becomes 4/3 when scaling to an equivalent fraction. Is the student correct? Explain why or why not.
Complete 2/3 = ?/6 and explain what happened to BOTH the numerator and denominator.

templates.base_instructions: Solve multi-step equivalent fraction challenges and create non-unit equivalent chains.
base_items: Find three equivalent fractions for 3/5 with denominators greater than 20.
A recipe calls for 6/8 cup of flour. Write this in simplest form and as an equivalent fraction with denominator 16.

templates.base_instructions: Teacher draws fraction bars on whiteboard; students explicitly label numerator and denominator while scaling up.
base_items: Draw 1/2 and 2/4 on whiteboard: circle top as numerator and box bottom as denominator.
Scale 1/3 to 2/6 on whiteboard and explain why numerator and denominator both doubled.

templates.base_instructions: Multiply numerators together and denominators together for each item.
